events.title: Prague: rival rallies over public-media funding: 'Běh pro svobodná média' run in support of ČT and ČRo in the morning; Svatopluk march to ČT at Kavčí hory against the licence fees in the afternoon (several hundred people by ČTK's estimate, 2,000 by the organisers'; SPD and Stačilo! speakers)
events.note: Not in the planning file. The cz-media story covers the public-media dispute, but its event is the coalition partners' position and Tuesday's student protest; it does not mention Saturday's rallies. The planning cz_shortfall says that no Saturday demonstration was found and that praha.eu and ČTK Předpokládané události were unreadable. A march with a set route (from Kongresové centrum to ČT) was very likely notified in advance to the Prague magistrate and listed in ČTK Předpokládané události, but I did not verify an advance announcement (one WebSearch found nothing). It is probably a sweep gap: these are exactly the sources the planning could not read. Oddity: the ČTK page carries a 'Komerční prezentace' label in its header.
